body.description: From a customer finding us to a paid order and the service after it: who does each step, where its work waits and where to read more. Copy it for your organization to rename steps and link your own procedures.

lanes.title: Sales and stores
lanes.description: Quoting, the stores and their orders.

lanes.title: Warehouse
lanes.description: Picking, packing, shipping and returned goods.

steps.title: Finds us
steps.description: Campaigns, the website and referrals bring a customer in. Marketing's campaigns and visits are not part of this installation yet, so this step is information only.

steps.title: Quote and negotiate
steps.description: A salesperson qualifies the opportunity and sends a quote. The Sales app is not part of this installation yet, so this step is information only.

steps.title: Shops in a store
steps.description: The customer fills a cart in one of the stores. Open carts are those not checked out yet.

steps.title: Places an order
steps.description: Checkout places the order; an order taken by a salesperson joins here. Orders are counted when placed, by the selling organization.

steps.title: Payment checked
steps.description: An order whose payment was not authorized is held until the customer pays or the hold is released.

steps.title: Order approved
steps.description: A placed order waits for approval before the warehouse sees it.

steps.title: Pick and pack
steps.description: Approved orders are released to picklists, picked from their locations and packed.

steps.title: Ship
steps.description: Packed shipments are labelled and handed to the carrier; shipping an order issues its stock.

steps.title: Returned goods received
steps.description: Goods sent back are received and inspected against their return authorization.

steps.title: Invoice
steps.description: Shipping an order invoices it. Invoiced revenue is the posted invoices of the period, each currency apart.

steps.title: Payment received
steps.description: Payments are applied to their invoices; what stays open ages in the receivables aging.

steps.title: Refund or credit
steps.description: An accepted return is refunded or credited against the customer's account.

steps.title: Help and questions
steps.description: A question or a problem becomes a case, worked in its queue under its service level.

steps.title: Return or exchange
steps.description: A return is authorized under the store's return policy and the customer sends the goods back.
